scope: Read-only integration peer review of seven worker modules; no source edits or new tests.

checks.conclusion: Counted-empty gates then CRT comparison, full owned key copy, first equivalent pointer wins, node/keys only destruction; raw parser pointers remain borrowed.
Two getter calls only after miss, second collision still returns true, encounter-order append before close, explicit unknown skip/nullopt, GroupParams detach and no implicit Mesh/Note tail skip.

Checked capacities protect width/count multiplication; physical COM reference has one owner, declaration and logical owner remain stable, output publishes only on success. Static private buffers do not enter raw dynamic registries; INDEX32 bypasses the shared INDEX16 recreation route.

Scale FF alone gates; selector2 requires shadow count. Signed per-stream count uses invariant cursor difference, remaining DWORD counters wrap and stop only at stream boundaries; source index resets and scale/offset writes replay in order. Native ECX increment is initialized to1 once before loopback00b429c5, consistent with host unit increments.
World affine transposition, first three ordered lights, absent zero fill and final visibility/count/diffuse-alpha overwrites match record offsets. Staged output avoids host alias overwrite.
Four ones/twelve zeros/ten; bit copy with ignored slot, flag before copy, mutable first-quartet alias without dirty write; source self-alias handled.

checks.topic: Special shadow sampler state and binding
checks.conclusion: Effect overall ordinal plus base pixel count, ordered post-prune map state overrides, retained fallback, ShadowTexture before ShadowMap, missing first light versus absent shadow owner versus existing null texture distinguished. No pixel-mask gating added.

remaining_documented_boundaries: Existing void Unlock APIs do not report GPU upload Unlock failure; already explicit in GPU backing report.
Parser pointers, material diffuse aliases, and LogicalTexture borrowed COM backing require their documented stable owner lifetimes; moved/destroyed callers must not reuse old aliases.
Bounds/invalid-input error policies and x87 NaN conversion exclusions are explicit host differences, not native ABI claims.
Mutable root integration files were excluded; caller ordering, lifetime placement and draw/probe correctness require primary verification after freeze.
validation: Static source/header/dependency review and bounded native evidence inspection only; no build, tests, or runtime performed by reviewer.

findings.before: Compiler passed false to shadow sampler configuration, silently fixing ShadowMap filtering to POINT.
findings.fix: MaterialPassCompileSettings.linear_shadow_map is passed to the configure helper; caller explicitly supplies settings.

findings.before: colors.insert/write_bitmap could throw while readback surface was locked, bypassing UnlockRect.
findings.fix: Local UnlockSurface guard now unlocks on exception; successful explicit unlock clears guard pointer.

ownership_checks: CompiledMaterialPass owns shader COM references; temporary bytecode/messages/disassembly buffers die before CompilerModule unload; no retained pointer into compiler buffers.
Mesh retained texture owners and shader owner outlive inner D3D9StateCache and logical wrappers; state restoration occurs after inner scope on HRESULT or caught exception exits.

FontGeometryOwner is destroyed before its borrowed state cache; its Impl destructor unbinds and releases owned shader references. Shared compiled shader owner remains alive across cache.clear and entire draw.
StructuredResourceRegistry is declared after concrete parsers and cleared before payload publication; moved output records own strings/vectors and do not borrow the reader or parser objects.
constant_and_scope_checks: Mesh diagnostic uses explicit camera/ambient/directional/fog/shadow inputs; it does not claim native world, shadow generation, or game postprocess.

Compiler now uses D3DX9_40, native VS1200/PS1400 flag choices, exact engine stem/mode/T-or-F/3 name for case-sensitive shore exception, and rejects embedded-NUL source outside the stated strlen-equivalent domain.

Mesh readback validates created buffer bytes, reflected decode constants, instance layout, texture identities/frequencies and nonempty varied pixels. These checks support a controlled host draw, not original-game visual parity.
Existing font wrapper preserves cached owner retention and font descriptor constraints while delegating compilation.
root_integration_review.validation_boundary: Static review only. Primary owns compilation and rerunning existing probes after the latest fixes; reported earlier build/draw success was not independently rerun by reviewer.
